description: A crumb was pressed. event.label and event.href are the crumb's, event.index is its position in `items` (the last crumb is the current page and is not a button).

label.description: The label of the crumb that was pressed.

href.description: The href of the crumb (empty if it has none).

index.description: The position of the crumb in `items`, from 0.
